Independent symbolic matrix multiplication verified the undamped identities. Conditioning at each iid step gives the exact all-k mean-square and mean norm laws, not a finite-time extrapolation. The derivative of F(z)=log(1+z²/2)/z reduces to g(s)=2s/(1+s)−log(1+s), whose derivative (1−s)/(1+s)^2 proves a unique positive maximum at s_*>1.
